title: Retail Installment Contracts State Note: Recovery of the Bank's Returned-Item Charge
content:
**Rule.** For a contract under Retail Installment Contracts whose contract state is **FL, GA or LA**, and a return dated on or after **1 July 2020** (2020-07-01), the returned-payment fee recovers the bank's own charge for the returned item:

- a returned ACH payment — a recurring autopay draft, a one-time self-service bank draft or a one-time bank draft taken by a representative — adds **2.50**;
- a returned mailed personal check adds **4.00**;
- every other return adds nothing.

| Contract state | Return date | Original channel | Bank-charge recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| FL, GA or LA | on or after 1 July 2020 | ACH (autopay, self-service draft, representative draft) | 2.50 |
| FL, GA or LA | on or after 1 July 2020 | mailed personal check | 4.00 |
| FL, GA or LA | on or after 1 July 2020 | debit card, MoneyGram, wire, certified funds, third-party remittance | nothing |
| FL, GA or LA | before 1 July 2020 | any | nothing |
| any other state | any | any | nothing |

The date read is the date of the return, not the contract date.

**Hypothetical cases.** A Louisiana contract's autopay draft returned on 30 June 2020: nothing. The same draft returned on 1 July 2020: 2.50.
